name: My Tiny Jungle
subtitle: Plant care that texts you
promotionalText: Your plants text you when they're thirsty, cold or just happy. Tell them what you did in one message, snap a sick leaf, share the watering at home. Free for 5 plants.
description:
Forget "water every 7 days". My Tiny Jungle works out what each of your plants actually needs, from your weather, your rooms, the pot and how fast the soil really dries. Then your plants just text you.

TELL THEM WHAT YOU DID
Type it like you'd text a friend: "watered Monty and Pesto". Done, it's logged for both. And yes, they answer, each in their own voice. Lily's a bit dramatic, Rosetta the succulent just wants to be left alone, Monty the monstera is calm about everything.

THEY TEXT YOU FIRST
Thirsty, cold, ready for food, outgrowing the pot: your plants send you a gentle note before it's a problem. Frost tonight? Heatwave tomorrow? You'll know the day before, so the balcony crew gets covered. One note a day at most, with quiet hours.

NOT A TIMER
Every plant's plan is worked out again every day. Rain skips the balcony. Heating dries pots faster in winter. Terracotta drinks faster than plastic. Seasons follow your hemisphere, so July is right in Lisbon and in São Paulo. Your soil checks teach it how fast each pot really dries.

YELLOW LEAVES? LET'S FIGURE IT OUT
Snap the leaf that's worrying you. You'll see what's probably going on, why it happened and a few easy steps to fix it today. Pests, droop, brown tips, root rot: explained in plain words.

SNAP THE WHOLE SHELF
Back from the garden centre? One photo names every plant on the shelf and each one arrives with its care ready. Holding a bag of fertiliser in the shop? Scan the label and see which of your plants will love it.

YOUR WHOLE WEEK IN ONE LOOK
What's coming up, who needs a little love, who just popped a new leaf, and what the weather's about to do to your pots. There are widgets too.

SHARE THE JUNGLE
Live with a partner, family or housemates? Everyone looks after the same plants, turns go to whoever did least, and nobody waters twice. Going away? It tells you who'll be fine and who needs a hand.

PLANT PASSPORT
Giving a plant away or leaving it with a friend? Send its care card with a link or QR code. Anyone can open it.

628 SPECIES AND COUNTING
Monstera, pothos, snake plant, peace lily, ZZ, orchids, herbs and veg, with light, soil, pest, repotting and cuttings guides, plus clear warnings for plants that aren't safe for cats, dogs or little ones.

ERTY HAS YOUR BACK
Erty, the little leaf on the icon, says hi when you start, asks a few easy questions about your home and sets everything up for you.

FREE TO START
Five plants are free forever, with chat, reminders and weather warnings, supported by small ads. Greenhouse (monthly) and Jungle (yearly) unlock unlimited plants, the plant doctor and the label scanner, and remove all ads. Subscriptions renew automatically until you cancel in your Apple account settings.

Your jungle is yours. No account needed. Sign in only if you want your jungle on all your devices or shared with your people.
